cd /workspace/tmp && cat > exp1.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import analyze
from analyze import parse_request, Model, as_int_value
import z3

inst = parse_request(json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/v05.jsonl')))
mdl = Model(inst); base = mdl.build()
C,S,E,K = mdl.C, mdl.S, mdl.E, mdl.K
fvars = [mdl.fvars[d] for d in mdl.observed_domains]
t0=time.time()
opt = z3.Optimize(); opt.add(base)
k=9
opt.add(z3.AtMost(*(fvars+[k]))); opt.add(z3.AtLeast(*(fvars+[k])))
print('setup %.3f' % (time.time()-t0))
print('objectives len', len(opt.objectives))
# single demand query timing, repeated
for trial in range(6):
    t=time.time()
    opt.push()
    h = opt.minimize(mdl.q[0][trial])
    r = opt.check()
    v = as_int_value(opt.lower(h))
    opt.pop()
    print('min q0_%d = %s in %.3fs  (objectives now %d)' % (trial, v, time.time()-t, len(opt.objectives)))
PYEOF
timeout 300 python3 exp1.py
